scope: Independent source/opening-code and nine final normalized rendered images; not structural, fabrication, or complete interior certification.

source_basis.excluded: B restoration drawings; hidden windows not recreated as exposed openings
source_basis.access_method: Read-only visual inspection of permitted renders; no extraction/decryption and no source imagery included.

checks.finding: Complete overview; four unequal chamfer fields, four transoms, shutter and covered diamonds; six crest accents and neutral badge visible.
Asymmetric cladding heights, south opening groups and roof stair enclosure remain distinct.
Three upper six-band windows and vents, two lower six-band/transom groups, closed infill, semicircle and circle with correct bars.
Three upper two-pane windows versus three lower six-band/transom groups; crest accents visible.
Four upper six-band groups plus semicircle; one small and two tall lower windows; cladding end has one window per storey.
Three upper northern two-pane fields and vents; one upper outer-cladding window; concealed original apertures not drawn through addition.
Pentagonal main footprint, split-height east addition, stair enclosure and two low circular base proxies.
Intentional crop; separate narrow/wide/wide/narrow fields and blank noticeboards conceal original diamonds.
Intentional crop; metal-window host distinct from masonry and stepped roofline visible.

resolved_findings.issue: Six crest accents buried inside parapet in v2.
resolved_findings.resolution: C plane changed to +0.12m with 0.08m relief; outer edge +0.20m exceeds parapet +0.15m. All six now visibly exposed in front and side projections.

resolved_findings.issue: Badge previously swallowed by crest and whole-image camera clipping.
resolved_findings.resolution: Neutral badge visible; all seven whole-building views retain entire building. Two detail crops intentional.

limitations: Graphical dimensions approximately ±3%, not new measured survey.
Member thicknesses, relief, cladding pitch and display colors are legibility proxies.
Opaque glazing and blind roof-door recess do not model complete interiors.
Badge fine detail and illegible text omitted; badge is not a clock.
South/east whole-elevation top clearance is narrow but no component is cut off.
No physical trial print or structural-safety claim.
